messages:
anna: quick report: bringing up sparrow-lite-int8 on the canary farm and seeing structured toolcall arrays with dropped trailing elements when streaming enabled. odd because non-stream and local fp16 runs pass.

rahul: can we get a minimal repro? streaming assembly or chunk corruption?

anna: repro (curl):
```bash
curl -sS -X POST https://canary.redwood/v1/invoke -d '{"model":"sparrow-lite-int8","prompt":"CALL tool list_entities()","stream":true,"seed":42}'
```

anna: assembled output we recorded:
```json
{"tool":"list_entities","args":[{"idx":0,"label":"alpha"},{"idx":1,"label":"beta"}]}
# expected third element {"idx":2,"label":"gamma"} sometimes appears as a separate top-level object or is missing entirely
```

zoe: can you paste chunk framing/token ids for a failing sample?

anna: trimmed tokens/chunks: chunks=[[12,34,255],[78,90,3],[4]] assembled=[12,34,255,78,90,3]  # trailing 4 dropped

kevin: that pattern smells like a stream assembly bug where the final chunk's first token becomes detached due to newline delimiting in our stream consumer. do we have any reassembly checksum or sequence numbers?

rahul: we don't; streaming is just newline-delimited JSON fragments. suggestion: add a 2-byte chunk-seq header and a short rolling checksum to each chunk for canary builds. cheap to add in user-level proxy.

canary-bot: alert: model=sparrow-lite-int8 canary: structured-output-parse-fail spike 2.1% (baseline 0.2%) — investigate https://canary.redwood/alerts/6175550012

zoe: other hypothesis: int8 PTQ kernels sometimes emit slightly different tokenization around sentinel sequences, pushing an extra token boundary that interacts poorly with our stream buffer. compare tokenizer outputs across kernels.

kevin: agreed. plan: (1) increase canary sampling to 4% for 3 hours (kevin), (2) enable per-chunk seq+checksum on canary proxy (rahul), (3) run 20k-seed replay with stream=true and stream=false and diff token-level assembly (anna+zoe), (4) add parse-detected fallback: on JSON parse error, re-invoke same request non-streamed (kevin).

rahul: note: fallback adds latency; gate by only triggering when checksum indicates missing bytes or when schema-parse fails for funcall and the payload looks truncated. keep metrics for fallback rate and added p99.

anna: starting replay now, pushing logs to #eng-ml-results with label=stream-assembly-probe-617555. will attach one raw trace when ready.

zoe: I'll write a small tokenizer-comparison script to run against the same prompt and seeds across fp16/int8 kernels and emit diffs.

kevin: if we see chunk seq gaps, we should also inspect our streaming ingress buffer in the SDK consumer. earlier bug where final newline consumed prematurely comes to mind. i'll run a quick SDK consumer unit test.

anna: FYI saw one trace where the missing element landed as a separate JSON object later in the stream (out-of-order chunk). might be a client-side reorder or our chunk emitter flushing twice. adding seq header should make this obvious.

canary-bot: note: created ticket ML-9273 for canary streaming parse investigation

rahul: timeline: will push proxy change in ~90m to staging, then canary patch. keep channel updated.

anna: thanks. if anyone can triage a quick mitigation (e.g., temporary disable streaming for this model in canary) post here; otherwise we'll reconvene after data collection. :thumbsup:
